Commentary.Commentary: Right then, that's all from this match. England lead the Super Series 12-8. The third ODI is in Nottingham on Tuesday. Do join us at 1830 IST for all the action. Cheers!!

JOE ROOT IS THE MAN OF THE MATCH! Says that his ankle is fine. Adds that he batted as per the situation and rotated the strike. Also says that he planned it ball-by-ball with the ball spinning and reversing. Informs that he will be fine for the next game.

Eoin Morgan looks happy and satisfied. He says that it was a very clinical performance. Praises his bowlers, Chris Woakes and Mark Wood in particular. Further says that his bowlers bowled with a lot of pace and control. Opines that the wicket was a bit on the slower side. Further says that they are playing some good cricket and feels they should not take the series lead for granted. Admits that there is still scope for improvement in the field. Regarding his own form, he replies that he is very pleased and also praises Root for his knock and the quality he brings in the side.

Azhar Ali says that his boys really fought hard which is a positive sign. Adds that Sarfraz scoring a hundred was one of the best knocks from him. Feels that the wicket was a good one and 300 was possible but after losing three early wickets 250 was still a good recovery. Also feels that they need to score 300 to win games. Adds that they have the capability and they need to apply themselves. Admits that in both games they were set for a score of 300 but failed to get there. Says that they are trying to find the perfect combination. Repeats that they have got a lot of positives and they are on the right track.

The Pakistani bowlers were impressive and tried their best but they did not have a big score on the board to reckon with. Ben Stokes scored a breezy 42 off 30 balls and was instrumental in helping England inch closer to victory. Moeen Ali survived an inspired spell of bowling from Wahab Riaz and Mohammad Amir and along with Chris Woakes saw his side through to victory.

England cruise to victory with four wickets in hand and 15 balls to spare. They are leading the series 2-0 now and are stamping their authority on the series. Joe Root stole the limelight with a brilliant knock of 89 runs and paved the way for England towards victory. He stitched a crucial partnership of over 100 runs with Eoin Morgan who also scored a gritty half century.

Thankfully, the rain has eased out and we are all set to resume. The English openers, Jason Roy and Alex Hales walk out to the middle. It will be Mohammad Amir to begin proceedings. Here we go again...
